thesis: July 30 was profitable, but three closed positions are not enough to justify changing setup enablement. The strongest improvement area is top-gainer exit allocation: SONACOMS left upside at both its profit-lock and final target exits. Any exact setting values remain a low-confidence analytics hypothesis because no replay was run.
caveats: Only 3 closed positions and 4 exit legs were available; every setup grade is Insufficient data.
The candidate rows are repeated observations across 298 snapshots, not independent trades.
Day-close opportunity is a benchmark, not proof that holding longer was feasible without larger adverse excursion.
Recommendations were derived from stored configuration, transactions, exit quality, setup efficiency, and snapshots only; no replay, backtest, or sweep was run.

recommendations.label: Setup enablement
recommendations.title: Keep all setup enable switches unchanged
recommendations.rationale: The date contains one Top Gainer Continuation position and two Momentum Runner positions. Other setups have snapshot activity but no closed positions, so enabling or disabling a setup from this date would overfit sparse outcome data.
evidence: Top Gainer Continuation: 1 trade, 100% win rate, ₹855.97 net
Momentum Runner: 2 trades, 50% win rate, ₹138.20 net
Both traded setup grades are Insufficient data
Detailed configuration confirms the enable switches currently use their defaults and were not overridden
recommendations.risk: Changing enable switches from a three-position sample could suppress valid setups based on one trading date.

validation.reason: Stored setup efficiency, transaction facts, snapshots, and effective configuration all support preserving the current enablement state.

recommendations.label: Top-gainer exit allocation
recommendations.title: Evaluate a smaller profit lock and slightly wider remainder trail
recommendations.rationale: SONACOMS left ₹382.80 after its profit-lock leg and ₹1,039.29 after its final target leg relative to the day close. The setup-specific controls expose a 25% partial quantity and a 0.35% remainder trail. Moving cautiously to 20% and 0.45% is a concrete next configuration hypothesis, not a validated change.
evidence: SONACOMS trailing/profit-lock exit: ₹176.66 realized net and ₹382.80 day-close opportunity
SONACOMS target exit: ₹679.31 realized net and ₹1,039.29 day-close opportunity
SIMULATION_TOP_GAINER_PARTIAL_QTY_PCT is 25, equals its default, and is not overridden
SIMULATION_TOP_GAINER_TRAIL_PCT is 0.35%, equals its default, and is not overridden
Only one Top Gainer Continuation position exists for the date
recommendations.risk: A smaller partial banks less profit and a wider trail can surrender more open gain. Review this pattern across additional dates before applying either value.

validation.reason: The mechanism is supported by transaction-level exit and configuration evidence, but one position is insufficient to infer expectancy and no replay was run.

recommendations.label: New setup hypothesis
recommendations.title: Research a post-extension pullback continuation setup
recommendations.rationale: The snapshot stream repeatedly classified extended candidates as CHASING. A future setup could wait for a pullback toward VWAP or EMA9, require a completed bullish reclaim with renewed relative volume, invalidate below the pullback low or VWAP, take partial profit near the prior intraday high, and trail the remainder.
evidence: VWAP Trend Continuation appeared only 44 times across 8 symbols
No outcome-labelled trades exist for the proposed pattern
recommendations.risk: Snapshot appearances are correlated and do not establish expectancy. Define de-duplication, entry timing, invalidation, costs, and multi-date outcome checks before implementing it.

validation.reason: The idea is derived from recurring snapshot states and has no executable rules or outcome validation.
